{"id":1520311808,"question_id":6,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 5 months","timestamp":1737830575,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"4 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1520311808/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Zigzag Conversion","memory":"14.2 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string convert(string s, int numRows) {\n      int row = 0, i =0;\n      bool direction = 1;\n\n      if(numRows == 1) return s;\n\n      vector<string>final(numRows);\n\n        while(i<s.size())\n        {\n            if(direction == 1)\n            {\n            while(i<s.size() && row<numRows)\n            {\n                final[row].push_back(s[i]);\n                row++ ; i++;\n            }\n                 row -= 2;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n            while(i<s.size() && row>=0) \n            {\n                final[row].push_back(s[i]);\n                row--; i++;\n            }\n                row = 1;\n            }\n            direction = !direction;\n        }\n\n        string ans =\"\";\n        for(auto str : final)\n        {\n            ans += str;\n        }\n    return ans ;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"zigzag-conversion","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":249}
